title: flair-eval truth sheet row (--truth CSV)
description: One orthogonal truth set for one end of one sample (CONTRACTS section 12, A36).

sample.description: a sample name from samples.csv (or the one-command --sample)

end.description: tss = 5' end (CAGE, PRO-cap, RAMPAGE ...), tes = 3' end (dRNA ...)

assay.description: the set's name in the report; unique per sample; refTSS and PolyA_DB are reserved

path.description: BED6 or wider of stranded sites; the interval in columns 1-3 is what is matched

provisional.description: true marks the set as provisional in the report (default false)
